lines: Salt wind. The sea brings things in, now and then.
npcStrand.greet.speaker: npcStrand

lines: The Downs are short of arrows. Carry five inland?
npcStrand.offer.speaker: npcStrand

lines: Five arrows, to the Downs waystone. Inland.
npcStrand.notReady.speaker: npcStrand

lines: The Downs light blinked back. Thank you. Take these.
npcStrand.thanks.speaker: npcStrand
